- v4.5.stable.mono.arch_linux
## System information:
Arch Linux 6.16.8-arch2-1

## Steps to reproduce
- create a scene
-  press play
- press stop

Tested on my actual project and a fresh one, and tried to reinstall godot.
As soon as I press the stop button godot freeze, and the whole system with.
Sometimes i can kill the process but a zombie one is left behind, and a couple of minutes after the system freeze have to hard reset the machine.
I've noticed the process before freeze is called 'godot.linuxbsd.editor" and after the freeze when it comes a zombie one "godot.linuxbsd.".
So right now I can't use godot...
I hope this details can help to fix this issue.

This Archlinux problem also occurred on 4.4.1 after I updated my system yesterday. So it is due to some external package that no longer plays nicely with Godot. A temporary measure I found was using [progzone122/archarchive](https://github.com/progzone122/archarchive) and rolling back to Sep. 16th (which was the last time I did a full system upgrade.)
So some package has been updated in the last week, and it breaks the way Godot uses the child process with the editor, leading to a zombie process, and a full window freeze.

I tested it on both Hyprland and KDE Plasma compositors. I also tried it on rolled back mesa drivers, as well as rolled-back pipewire, but to no avail.
On arch this was due to a kernel bug which is fixed now https://bbs.archlinux.org/viewtopic.php?id=308427

It does **not** freeze on my Framework laptop, which is running the same version of Bazzite but with an integrated Intel GPU. If there's _anything_ I can do to debug this more, I'd love to hear it.

I notice OP's video capture uses a floating window. Is it possible this is related to this? https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/114986 Especially with some commenters noting it occurs on Nvidia GPUs and not integrated Intel GPUs. 

Someone from that issue notes the following which may be relevant:

> Not sure if it helps find the underlying cause, but debugging godot while I reproduce the freeze shows every thread in __syscall_cancel_arch being called from the NVidia driver.

Turning on Editor Settings > interface/editor/single_window_mode resolves my freeze.

Edit: Those who do have an Nvidia GPU, try upgrading to driver version 590.x or beyond! This fixed my issue.
In my case I was using an integrated intel GPU. But since the 4.6 update, I barely have any crash. The update seems to have fix the main issue with me.
